text:
The boys scatter them with their hands and feet, demolish them,
dismantle them and render them unplayable. Even so, Rādha, you all
scatter form, feeling, perception, preparations, consciousness.
Practise for the destruction of craving.
plain: The boys scatter them with their hands and feet, demolish them, dismantle them and render them unplayable. Even so, Radha, you all scatter form, pleasant-or-unpleasant tone, perception, things the mind makes, consciousness. Practise for the wanting ends.

text:
The sun, the moon and the stars shine precisely because of the presence
of darkness. In the non-manifestative consciousness there is absolutely
no darkness for them to shine forth.

say: The sun, the moon and the stars shine precisely because of the presence of darkness. In the non-manifestative — with nowhere to land — consciousness there is absolutely no darkness for them to shine forth.

text:
Now that the five elements have been totally removed, the residual
function of consciousness amounts to a discrimination between the three
grades of feelings.

say: Now that the five elements have been totally removed, the residual function of consciousness amounts to a discrimination between the three grades of pleasant-or-unpleasant tone.

text:
With the cessation of that concept of a gem as some special thing, a
valuable thing, separate from the rest of the world... the gem ceases
to exist. That itself is the deliverance.

say: With the stopping of that concept of a gem as some special thing, a valuable thing, separate from the rest of the world... the gem ceases to exist. That itself is the deliverance.

text:
He declares that he has seen well in advance 'the barb on which
mankind is hooked impaled'. The barb is none other than the dogmatic
assertion, 'I know, I see, it is verily so'.

say: He declares that he has seen well in advance 'the barb on which mankind is hooked impaled'. The barb is none other than the dogmatic assertion, 'I know, I see, it is verily so'.
